cases.title: Qualify changed exact sandbox contract
cases.trigger: Trusted synthetic control source only; refreshed exact spec/image/program/daemon binding
cases.expected: Actual enforcing controls and reviewable operator evidence, not integrated-worker PASS
cases.technicalNeed: Old successful six cases used a different contract/image/harness and their attestation window cannot be renewed by restamping old output.
cases.fault: Six explicit control variants: base controls, output, timeout, cancellation, memory, owned orphan; no implicit extra variants

cases.title: One real job to enforcing sandbox
cases.trigger: Fresh Auth -> real immutable GitHub snapshot -> private leased capability -> exact trusted probe in Docker
cases.expected: Source manifest/digest match, real kernel controls, foundation_sandbox_verified audit, truthful no-scanner result, independent owned cleanup absence
cases.technicalNeed: First actual worker-to-sandbox composition; old job never reached Docker.

cases.title: Fail closed on invalid enforcement evidence
cases.trigger: Three real-daemon readiness checks with missing, expired, or mismatched negative evidence operands
cases.expected: Denied before create/start; no fabricated positive evidence and zero durable jobs
cases.technicalNeed: Changed production contract against actual daemon rather than driver doubles.
cases.fault: Negative evidence objects are explicit test operands; outer control approval remains valid and is never backdated

cases.title: Normal owner session revocation
cases.trigger: After real acquisition and before probe admission, owner logs out through existing normal UI; fresh resolution must reject
cases.expected: No foundation success/container; owned source disposed; lease settled; after owner restores normal session, one approved cancel terminalizes any retained queued/preparing residue
cases.technicalNeed: Live existing Auth/IPC revocation with real resources; synthetic broker rejection already covered but is not this proof.
cases.fault: Owner-session logout only. No GitHub App uninstall/access writes and no raw Auth-store edits. GitHub provider-permission revocation remains a distinct unproven scope.

cases.title: Live in-flight cancellation
cases.trigger: Cancel the exact job after its owned container is observed running
cases.expected: Cancelled scan/queue/attempt, no successful foundation audit, released lease, stopped heartbeat and no owned container/source
cases.technicalNeed: Actual owner route -> DB flag -> lease/IPC/container cancellation chain, beyond completed DB fixture cancellation.
cases.fault: One normal same-origin exact-job cancel; no module-wide shutdown

cases.title: Actual permit expiry during work
cases.trigger: Shortened worker subpermit expires on the real clock at 90 seconds while approved hold probe is running
cases.expected: No protected forward write after expiry; cleanup-only authority settles owned resources and retained job within outer valid control window
cases.technicalNeed: Real expired in-flight capability instead of fake-clock/unit checks.
cases.fault: Real expiry; no Date mock/backdating. Role/cleanup permit remains independently valid; new work is never extended.

cases.title: Actual short-lived grant expiry
cases.trigger: Hold the actually minted 60-second grant at an exact private checkpoint for at least 61 seconds, then exercise its existing authorize boundary
cases.expected: Expired grant denied before source/probe/foundation write; no forged grant or replacement token; explicit cancel of retained case job
cases.technicalNeed: Live real-clock expiry of a real Auth grant, distinct from operator-permit expiry.
cases.fault: A scope-bound private pause only; no globally disabled heartbeat/Auth or modified grant TTL

cases.title: Integrated container timeout
cases.trigger: Trusted hold program exceeds exact 1500ms sandbox deadline
cases.expected: Native process/container bounded termination, fixed safe failure, no foundation success, cleanup and one explicit retained-job cancel if needed
cases.technicalNeed: Proves actual timeout propagation through worker/lease/IPC/source ownership, not repetition of the standalone passed probe.
cases.fault: No arbitrary repo command or host execution

cases.title: Source-timeout partial cleanup
cases.trigger: Exact private source checkpoint after at least one bounded blob write waits for the existing real 45-second abort
cases.expected: Partial source root removed, close honored, no container/foundation success, bounded failure and explicit case cancel
cases.technicalNeed: Live resource/IPC/DB cleanup at source timeout was not proven by the successful snapshot.
cases.fault: Controlled local delay honors real AbortSignal; label LIVE_INJECTED_SOURCE_TIMEOUT, not a claim of an actual GitHub outage

cases.title: Container cleanup failure and rescue
cases.trigger: One exact-case cleanup boundary deliberately denies the first owned-container removal
cases.expected: cleanup_failed surfaces; no accepted success; separately preapproved rescue removes only the registered actual ID and verifies absence; no work retry
cases.technicalNeed: Actual owned resources and failure surface/rescue protocol were not exercised in the positive run.
cases.fault: LIVE_INJECTED_CLEANUP_FAILURE; clearly distinguish boundary injection from an OS/daemon outage. One rescue action is an explicit part of this case, not automatic job retry.

cases.title: Actual Windows source-delete refusal and rescue
cases.trigger: Trusted owner helper opens one registered owned snapshot file with delete sharing denied, without reading its contents
cases.expected: Real OS deletion refusal is surfaced, no foundation success; release only the owned handle and explicitly rescue the exact confined root/own .lease
cases.technicalNeed: Actual filesystem cleanup failure, unlike mocked remove failure or successful cleanup.
cases.fault: Windows helper must be implemented/hashed first; no chmod/ACL changes, source writes, global file handles or unrelated process termination

cases.title: Child crash, natural reclaim and stale fencing
cases.trigger: Terminate only exact recorded worker A PID/creation identity after real resource acquisition; wait natural lease expiry, then fresh-authorized worker B on this same NEW case job
cases.expected: Two real attempts/fences1->2; a controlled old opaque lease capability write is rejected without audit changes; no physical container overlap and final owned cleanup
cases.technicalNeed: Existing process smoke uses queue doubles, while old real positive run had no crash/restart.
cases.fault: Old token retained only privately for one denied stale-capability replay; never exported. No PostgreSQL/daemon/Sentinel/unrelated process kill.

cases.title: Parent crash, physical overlap denial and recovery
cases.trigger: Owner abruptly stops only the verified sole candidate app/child process tree after a registered container starts; restore the same single app normally; attempt B after lease expiry while orphan container remains; recover with C after owned cleanup
cases.expected: A crashes; B must fail closed before any second live container despite logical lease availability; after actual orphan deadline/cleanup C completes with fence3. One expired private source root remains in documented custody pending Window B.
cases.technicalNeed: Actual parent death/orphan resources and physical-overlap admission were not shown by graceful lifecycle or child-only crash.
cases.fault: Explicit owner downtime action affects the candidate app's Auth/Canvas availability. No second Auth writer, daemon/service restart or unrelated process kill. Root custody is private and bounded until new cleanup window.

cases.title: Real-aged source orphan cleanup only
cases.trigger: New approval after the C02A root has actually aged >=3600000ms and expired under unchanged marker metadata
cases.expected: GuardSnapshotAdapter.reapExpired removes only the exact registered root and its own .lease; actual absence independently observed; historical markers untouched
cases.technicalNeed: Unscheduled real source reaper has a one-hour real-age condition that does not fit the old 55-minute permit.
cases.fault: Never simulate Date.now, rewrite marker, reuse old permit or enumerate/delete unrelated temp roots

cases.title: Real already_applied schema path, zero DDL
